spec.hypothesis: ACR-VLA with per-DOF conformal features (CGS 40D) enables dimension-selective correction on SmolVLA, improving OOD robustness on LIBERO without degrading nominal performance
spec.description: Full pipeline: SmolVLA frozen + CGS(K=10, H_eff=5, action_dim=6) → 40D features + 30D mean_action → CRM(MLP 2x256) → refined action. Train on LIBERO-Spatial+Object, eval on LIBERO standard + LIBERO-Plus
